C: C2 a public meeting of a large group of people, especially supporters of a particular opinion
（尤指為表明支援某種主張的）集會，群衆大會
C2 a car or motorcycle race, especially over long distances on public roads
（尤指長距離的）公路汽車賽；（汽車或機車）拉力賽
› a continuous exchange of hits between players in tennis, squash or badminton
（網球等比賽中）持續對打，相持，拉鋸戲

I or T: › [ I or T ] to (cause to) come together in order to provide support or make a shared effort

I: › [ I ] to return to a better condition

example: 5,000 people held an anti-nuclear rally.

an election/campaign rally
